code:
# Robot-diversity chain RECEIVER (UR10 stage-k): picks a relayed cube off a FLAT tray -> bin.
create_scene_baseline(table_size=[3.0, 1.0])

create_prim(prim_path="/World/UR10", prim_type="Xform")
add_reference(prim_path="/World/UR10", reference_path="/mnt/shared_data/isaac-sim-assets-complete-5.0.0/Assets/Isaac/5.0/Collected_Robots/ur10.usd")
teleport_prim(prim_path="/World/UR10", position=[0, 0, 0.75])

# FLAT handoff tray IN FRONT (reachable: CP-CHAIN-UR10-SRC's UR10 DELIVERS to this exact spot).
# Cube edge 2m, scale -> half-extents [0.15,0.15,0.01], centre z=0.74 -> TOP z=0.75.
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Tray", prim_type="Cube", position=[0.5, -0.4, 0.74], scale=[0.15, 0.15, 0.01])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Tray", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")

# Relayed cube resting on the tray (centre 0.80 -> settles to 0.775 on top z=0.75).
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", prim_type="Cube", position=[0.5, -0.4, 0.80], size=0.05)
for api in ("PhysicsRigidBodyAPI", "PhysicsCollisionAPI", "PhysicsMassAPI", "PhysxRigidBodyAPI"):
    apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", schema_name=api)
bulk_set_attribute(prim_paths=["/World/Cube_1"], attr="physxRigidBody:sleepThreshold", value=0.0)
apply_physics_material(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", material_name="rubber")

# Destination bin at the (reachable) far side — where CP-CHAIN-UR10-SRC's pedestal pick is.
create_bin(prim_path="/World/Bin", position=[-0.5, 0.4, 0.75], size=[0.3, 0.3, 0.12])

setup_pick_place_controller(
    robot_path="/World/UR10",
    robot_family="ur10",
    target_source="curobo",
    source_paths=["/World/Cube_1"],
    destination_path="/World/Bin",
    drop_target=[-0.5, 0.4, 0.85],
    planning_obstacles=["/World/Bin"],
)
